info.title: Speko API
info.description: Public REST API for the Speko voice gateway. Routes, transcribes, synthesizes, and completes via the highest-scoring provider for your routing intent, with transparent server-side failover.

post.description: Mints browser-safe media transport credentials, persists the pipeline config, and dispatches an agent worker. Use the returned `transportToken` and `transportUrl` with `@spekoai/client` to join from a browser.

get.description: Returns sessions visible to the calling key, newest first. Supports cursor pagination and filtering by `status`, `kind`, and `agent`. All filters combine via AND.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a prior call. Omit on the first page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max number of entries to return.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Filter to sessions started against this agent. Matches sessions whose `pipelineConfig.agentId` equals this value. Combines with other filters via AND.

post.description: Creates a voice session, dispatches the configured agent worker, and dials the destination over LiveKit SIP. Supply either `agentId` or `intent`.

Routes the request to the best STT provider for your `(language, region, optimizeFor)` intent, with automatic failover to runner-up providers before the first event is emitted. Body is binary audio. Routing intent goes in the `x-speko-intent` header (JSON). The response is a Server-Sent Events stream: `meta`, `transcript`, `done`, and `error`.

parameters.name: x-speko-constraints
parameters.description: Optional JSON-encoded `PipelineConstraints`. Each `allowedProviders` entry is either `"<vendor>"` (any model from that vendor) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (a specific model). Example: `{"allowedProviders":{"stt":["deepgram:nova-3"]}}`.

parameters.name: x-speko-stt-options
parameters.description: Optional JSON-encoded STT options. Example: `{"keywords":["Speko","Ava Martinez"]}`.

requestBody.description: Binary audio. WAV, MP3, or raw PCM accepted.

schema.description: SSE events: `meta` with provider/model, zero or more `transcript` events, final `done` containing a `TranscribeResponse`, or `error` after streaming has started.

get.description: Returns the curated catalog of TTS voices grouped by provider, plus the list of TTS providers Speko routes to. ElevenLabs is included in `providers` with `voicesFetchedLive: true` because its voice library is account-scoped — fetch it directly from `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/voices` with the org's key.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Filter to a single provider's voices. Accepts either the routing key (`cartesia`, `xai`, `alibaba`, `openai`, `inworld`, `elevenlabs`) or the catalog suffix form (`xai-tts`, `alibaba-tts`, `openai-tts`).

post.description: Routes the request to the best TTS provider for your intent, with automatic failover before the first audio chunk. Returns chunked binary audio. The `Content-Type` header (mirrored in `X-Speko-Audio-Format`) tells you the format.

X-Speko-Provider.description: Provider that actually handled the request.

X-Speko-Failover-Count.description: Number of providers tried before success.

X-Speko-Scores-Run-Id.description: Benchmark snapshot id used for routing.

post.description: Single-turn LLM call routed to the best provider for your intent, with automatic failover before the first event is emitted. The response is a Server-Sent Events stream: `meta`, `delta`, `tool_call`, `server_tool_call`, `done`, and `error`.

schema.description: SSE events: `meta`, zero or more `delta` and tool events, final `done` containing a `CompleteResponse`, or `error` after streaming has started.

get.description: Returns every agent belonging to the authenticated organization. Agents are scoped per-org — IDs from another org will never appear here.

200.description: Agents owned by the authenticated organization.

post.description: Persists a reusable voice persona — `systemPrompt`, optional `voice`, routing `intent`, and optional `llmOptions` — keyed by `name` within the authenticated organization. Pass the returned `id` as `agentId` on `POST /v1/sessions` to seed a session from this agent.

get.description: Fetch a single agent by id. Scoped to the authenticated organization — agents owned by another org always return 404.

patch.description: Partial update — every field on the body is optional and only supplied keys are written.

delete.description: Removes the agent and its registered tools. The organization's only remaining agent cannot be deleted and returns 409.

get.description: Returns recent calls whose session pipeline config references this agent. Results are newest first and support cursor pagination.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only include calls created at or after this timestamp.

get.description: Returns every (vendor, model) pair the router knows about per pipeline layer, plus one vendor-wildcard row per vendor. The `id` field on each entry is the verbatim string callers put into `allowedProviders` on session create, transcribe, synthesize, complete, or `stackPreferences` on an agent. Use this to populate UI pickers or validate user-supplied allowlists.
Returns managed and customer SIP-trunk phone numbers registered to the authenticated organization.

post.description: Orders a platform-managed phone number and registers it for inbound and/or outbound calling. Business verification and sufficient credits are required.

get.description: Searches the platform-managed phone-number pool. Business verification and the buy-phone-numbers feature flag are required.

post.summary: Import a SIP trunk phone number
post.description: Registers a customer-owned phone number from an installed SIP connection or a legacy outbound trunk id.

get.description: Returns the latest business verification submission and optional 10DLC-derived prefill.
Returns the call session, transcript, report if available, transfer attempts, and recording metadata.

post.description: Runs or re-runs analysis for a call and optionally retries post-call webhook delivery.

get.summary: Get a signed URL for the session recording
get.description: Returns a 302 redirect to a short-lived (5 minute) signed Google Cloud Storage URL for the mixed-mono Opus recording of this session. Follow the redirect to download the file — clients should pass the equivalent of `curl -L`. The signed URL is single-use within its TTL window; refetch this endpoint to get a fresh one. Recordings are retained for 30 days after the session ends, then deleted by a GCS lifecycle policy.

302.description: Redirect to a signed GCS URL valid for 5 minutes. The URL is returned in the `Location` header; the response body is empty.

Location.description: Short-lived signed GCS URL. Follow to download the recording.

404.description: No recording exists for this session — either the id is unknown to the calling organization, recording was suppressed (`recordingStatus: "suppressed"`), the session is still in flight (`pending` / `uploading`), or the upload failed (`failed`). Inspect the parent session entry to disambiguate.

post.description: Append finalized STT and LLM turns to a session's transcript. Worker-only — the agent worker batches and debounces (~200ms) finalized turns and POSTs them here. Interim STT partials are not accepted; only finalized turns are persisted. Idempotent on `(session_id, index)`: re-posting a turn with the same index replaces the existing entry, so retries on transient errors are safe.

202.description: Turns accepted for persistence. Response body is empty.

404.description: Session id is unknown to the calling organization.

get.description: Returns every finalized STT and LLM turn captured during the session, sorted by `index` ascending. The dashboard's session detail page surfaces these under the Transcript card. S2S sessions don't currently produce transcripts (the audio path bypasses our STT/LLM components) — expect an empty `entries` array for those. Interim STT partials are never returned; only finalized turns make it into this response.

200.description: Full transcript for the session, ordered by `index`.

404.description: Session id is unknown to the calling organization.

region.description: Region whose streaming-latency measurements should be used. `global` falls through to batch-mode rows when no per-region data matches.

allowedProviders.description: Restrict candidate pool per modality. Router still ranks by score. Each entry is either `"<vendor>"` (vendor wildcard — allow any model from that vendor) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (allow only that specific model). Failover stays active across all entries in the layer.

items.description: Allowed STT provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"deepgram"` — any Deepgram model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"deepgram:nova-3"` — only Nova-3, no fallback to other Deepgram models within the vendor). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.
Allowed LLM provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"openai"` — any OpenAI model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"openai:gpt-5"` — only that model). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

Allowed TTS provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"elevenlabs"` — any ElevenLabs model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"elevenlabs:eleven_flash_v2_5"` — only that model). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

Allowed S2S provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"openai"` — any OpenAI realtime model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"openai:gpt-realtime"` — only that model). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

region.description: Optional SIP routing region hint forwarded as `X-Speko-Region`.

agentId.description: Persisted agent to run. Required unless `intent` is supplied.

callControlId.description: LiveKit SIP participant identity for the outbound leg.

sipConnectionInstallationId.description: Installed SIP connection integration id. Preferred for new imports.

sipTrunkId.description: Legacy outbound trunk id. Required when `sipConnectionInstallationId` is omitted.

executionMode.description: Where the tool runs. Omit for inline execution.

source.description: Webhook, builtin, or inline execution source config.

toolCallId.description: Required on `role: tool`; pairs with a prior assistant tool call id.

isError.description: Marks a tool message as an error result.

CreateSessionRequest.description: Cascade-mode session creation body. Exactly one of `agentId` or `intent` must be supplied. When `agentId` is given, the persisted agent's `systemPrompt`, `voice`, `intent`, and `llmOptions` seed the session as defaults; any per-call field on this body still overrides the agent's stored value.

agentId.description: Optional pointer to a persisted `agent` row whose fields seed this session. When supplied, the agent's `systemPrompt`, `voice`, `intent`, and `llmOptions` become defaults; any per-call field on this body overrides the agent's stored value. When absent, `intent` is required.

voice.description: Force a specific TTS voice id.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value pairs stored on the session row.

id.description: Voice id passed through to the provider's TTS API.

voicesFetchedLive.description: `true` when the provider's voice library is account-scoped and must be fetched live from the provider (currently ElevenLabs).

voice.description: Provider-specific voice id. Speko falls back to a sane default per provider when omitted.

model.description: Optional upstream model name (e.g. `eleven_multilingual_v2`, `sonic-2`, `gpt-4o-mini-tts`, `qwen3-tts-flash`). When set, overrides the selector's chosen model on the primary candidate only — failover candidates still use the selector's model so a model intended for provider A is not sent to provider B.

systemPrompt.description: Forwarded via the canonical system-prompt slot. Don't *also* prepend the same content as a `system` message.

AgentIntent.description: Routing defaults stored on an agent row. Hydrated into a session's `RoutingIntent` when the session is created with `agentId` and no inline `intent`. Note: agents accept a smaller `optimizeFor` enum than the per-session `RoutingIntent`.

AgentLlmOptions.description: Optional LLM tuning defaults stored on an agent. Strict object — only these three keys are accepted.

model.description: Pin a specific LLM model id. When omitted, the router picks per intent.

Agent.description: Reusable voice persona — `systemPrompt` + optional `voice` + routing `intent` defaults, plus optional `llmOptions`. Pass the `id` as `agentId` on `POST /v1/sessions` to seed a session from this agent.

organizationId.description: Owning organization. Always equal to the authenticated org — agents are never visible across orgs.

name.description: Human-readable name. Unique within an organization.

systemPrompt.description: Initial agent instructions. Hydrated as the session's `systemPrompt` default when no per-call value is supplied.

voice.description: Default TTS voice id. `null` when unset — the router picks a sane default per provider.

llmOptions.description: Optional LLM tuning defaults. `null` when unset.

stackPreferences.description: Per-agent stack preferences. `null` when the agent has no preferences set.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Does not need to be unique — agents are identified by `id`.

systemPrompt.description: Initial agent instructions used as the session-level `systemPrompt` default.

voice.description: Default TTS voice id. Omit to let the router pick per provider.

UpdateAgentRequest.description: Partial update — every field is optional. Only supplied keys are written.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Does not need to be unique — agents are identified by `id`.

AgentStackPreferences.description: Per-agent stack preferences. Empty / missing layers leave the router unconstrained for that layer; failover stays active within the allowed set.

allowedProviders.description: Per-pipeline-layer provider allowlists (e.g. STT must be Deepgram or AssemblyAI). Each entry is either `"<vendor>"` (vendor wildcard — allow any model from that vendor) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (allow only that specific model). Failover stays active across all entries in the layer.

items.description: Allowed STT provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"deepgram"` — any Deepgram model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"deepgram:nova-3"` — only Nova-3, no fallback to other Deepgram models within the vendor). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

stt.description: Allowed STT provider entries. Empty / absent = no constraint.

items.description: Allowed LLM provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"openai"` — any OpenAI model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"openai:gpt-5"` — only that model). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

llm.description: Allowed LLM provider entries. Empty / absent = no constraint.

items.description: Allowed TTS provider entry. Either a vendor id (e.g. `"elevenlabs"` — any ElevenLabs model) or `"<vendor>:<model>"` (e.g. `"elevenlabs:eleven_flash_v2_5"` — only that model). Both forms can be mixed in the same array.

tts.description: Allowed TTS provider entries. Empty / absent = no constraint.

ProviderModelEntry.description: A single allowlist-eligible entry returned by `/v1/providers/known`. The `id` is the verbatim string callers put into `allowedProviders` — either a vendor wildcard (`"deepgram"`) or a specific (vendor, model) pair (`"deepgram:nova-3"`).

id.description: Verbatim string for `allowedProviders` entries. `"<vendor>"` for vendor-wildcard rows, `"<vendor>:<model>"` for model-specific rows.

model.description: Model id within the vendor, or `null` for the vendor-wildcard row.

benchmarked.description: Whether the router has benchmark data for this entry. `false` entries are visible but cannot win selection — including them in `allowedProviders` without a benchmarked fallback will fail to route.

KnownProviders.description: Per-modality lists of allowlist-eligible entries. Each layer's array contains one vendor-wildcard row per known vendor plus one row per known (vendor, model) pair. Use the `id` field as the verbatim string for `allowedProviders`.

nextCursor.description: Cursor to pass to the next call. Null/absent when there are no more pages.

pipelineConfig.description: Snapshot of the pipeline config the session was minted with.

agentId.description: The agent the session was started against, if any. Filtered on by the `?agent=` query param.

recordingObjectPath.description: GCS object path of the recorded audio file, when a recording exists. Null while the recording is still being produced, when recording is suppressed for the organization, or when the upload failed. Use `GET /v1/sessions/{id}/recording` to fetch a short-lived signed URL — never construct one yourself.

recordingDurationMs.description: Duration of the finalized recording in milliseconds. Null until `recordingStatus` is `ready`.

recordingStatus.description: Lifecycle of this session's recording. `pending` after the call ends and before the agent worker has finished assembling the file. `uploading` while the file is being pushed to GCS. `ready` once it is fully persisted and downloadable via the signed-URL endpoint. `failed` if the upload errored — the recording is unrecoverable. `suppressed` for organizations whose `recordingEnabled` flag is false; no file was ever produced. Null on legacy sessions that predate the recording feature.

index.description: Monotonically increasing position of this turn within the session, starting at 0. The `(session_id, index)` pair is the idempotency key — re-posting a turn with the same index replaces the prior entry.

source.description: Who produced this turn. `user` = finalized STT from the caller. `agent` = finalized LLM output spoken by the agent. `system` = synthetic entries (e.g. session boundary markers).

text.description: Finalized transcript text. Interim STT partials are not accepted.

startedAt.description: Wall-clock time at which the turn began, ISO 8601.

endedAt.description: Wall-clock time at which the turn ended, ISO 8601. Null while the turn is still considered open (e.g. a streaming agent reply that hasn't fully closed).

provider.description: Provider that produced this turn (e.g. `deepgram`, `openai`). Null for `system` turns.

model.description: Specific model id within the provider (e.g. `nova-3`, `gpt-4o-mini`). Null for `system` turns.

id.description: Server-assigned id for this turn entry. Stable across reads.

index.description: Monotonically increasing position of this turn within the session, starting at 0.

startedAt.description: Wall-clock time at which the turn began, ISO 8601.

endedAt.description: Wall-clock time at which the turn ended, ISO 8601. Null if the turn is still open.

provider.description: Provider that produced this turn. Null for `system` turns.

model.description: Specific model id within the provider. Null for `system` turns.

turns.description: Batch of finalized turns to ingest. Workers should debounce (~200ms) and batch — single-turn POSTs are accepted but inefficient at scale.

entries.description: Finalized turns for this session, ordered by `index` ascending.

ValidationError.description: Request body or query parameters failed validation.

InvalidAudio.description: Empty body, missing/invalid `x-speko-intent` header, or malformed `x-speko-constraints`.

TranscribeFailed.description: No STT provider available for the intent, or every candidate failed.

SynthesizeFailed.description: No TTS provider available for the intent, no default voice for chosen provider, or every candidate failed.

CompleteFailed.description: No LLM provider available for the intent, or every candidate failed.

SessionCreateFailed.description: Token mint failed, agent dispatch failed, or DB insert failed.

AgentNotFound.description: No agent with this id exists in the authenticated organization.

AgentDeleteConflict.description: The organization's only remaining agent cannot be deleted.

value.error: Cannot delete the only agent in this organization
